name: anaconda_constricting_caiman
description: Green anaconda (green_anaconda palette) wrapped in three loops around a spectacled caiman: the caiman tilted nose-up, its tail sticking out at an angle on the left, its head poking out on the right with the jaws open (teeth, dark-red mouth); the anaconda's tail on the ground behind and its head raised over the caiman's back at the right. A struggle, no blood. Anchor bottom-centre, ~800x320.
